_doc: Ballistic Shield (Fuze). research/weapons.csv row ballistic_shield; rules research/weapons_notes.md §5; built in Phase 8 M11 (gadgets/DESIGN.md §8). Held with the secondary pistol: no hip fire; aiming takes `pistolAdsS` and lowers the plate's top under the eyes. Bash damage 0 (Y9S4, the official Collision Point page) supersedes fuze.md's 65 (Y9S1). The bash knocks a body down: shoved back onto its back, up again a couple of seconds later, its player's input ignored meanwhile (D-156; Fandom: like Oryx's dash and Nomad's Airjab; data/combat.json `knockdown`); on a raised shield's plate it knocks the shield aside instead (a guard break, any melee: Y9S1). Bullets stop at its plate (hits suppress the carrier: 5 to start, 20 at most, ~7 s to fade). A blast from in front loses 66% (Y9S1.3); one of 30 hp or more, a knife or a stun knocks it aside (guard break, ~1 s); Sledge's hammer knocks him to the ground (Y10S2). Its plate is the game's model as its renders show it (D-157): a green, all but flat plate about 0.58 × 1.1 m, its top corners cut, a dark rim, and a framed viewport of bulletproof glass across its upper part at eye height (Fandom: 'a panel of bulletproof glass at the operator's eye level'); held up it covers head and torso, the legs out under it standing (Fandom); it slides down as he aims. The plate's numbers are measured off the renders (ours), and so is the guard break's length.
name: Ballistic Shield
